last: Then the Eye turned the other way, and they all began to talk together about the Eye’s strange delusion.
And they said, “Something must be the matter with the Eye.”
Last night I invented a new pleasure, and as I was giving it the first trial an angel and a devil came rushing toward my house.
They met at my door and fought with each other over my newly created pleasure; the one crying, “It is a sin!”—the other, “It is a virtue!”
